display_name: Honda Keihin PGM-FI (raw diagnostic tables, read-only)
notes: Source-listed Honda Keihin PGM-FI models are eligible for a diagnostic attempt, not confirmed fitment of this implementation. ECU and table support vary by model, market and software. This integration has synthetic tests only. Read-only diagnostic table queries and raw ID candidate; table 10/11/17 engine speed and temperature are unverified candidates. No ECU memory, controls, DTCs, flashing or simulator.

session.physical_evidence_note: Sources list PGM-FI models or relevant K-Line ECU examples; Dynojet lists CRF110F for its tool. This separate integration has synthetic tests only; model-specific compatibility is not physically verified.

identification.note: Raw five-byte ECM ID candidate only; not a verified ECU identity.

memory.write_blocked_reason: No ECU memory read or write in this profile.
